rows.Kwic: 師問：刈得幾个祖師頭？座云：三十個。師云：那個皮下有血？

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yu'an Zhiji (愚菴智及禪師語錄). Yu'an Zhiji is the exact speaker: after the unnamed cook says that he has cut thirty patriarchs' heads while slicing melons, Yu'an asks which one has blood beneath its skin.
